name: ses
description: Amazon Simple Email Service This document contains reference information for the Amazon Simple Email Service (Amazon SES) API, version 2010-12-01.

subcommands.name: clone-receipt-rule-set
subcommands.description: Creates a receipt rule set by cloning an existing one.

subcommands.name: create-configuration-set
subcommands.description: Creates a configuration set.

subcommands.name: create-configuration-set-event-destination
subcommands.description: Creates a configuration set event destination.

subcommands.name: create-configuration-set-tracking-options
subcommands.description: Creates an association between a configuration set and a custom domain for open and click event tracking.

subcommands.name: create-custom-verification-email-template
subcommands.description: Creates a new custom verification email template.

subcommands.name: create-receipt-filter
subcommands.description: Creates a new IP address filter.

subcommands.name: create-receipt-rule
subcommands.description: Creates a receipt rule.

subcommands.name: create-receipt-rule-set
subcommands.description: Creates an empty receipt rule set.

subcommands.name: create-template
subcommands.description: Creates an email template.

subcommands.name: delete-configuration-set
subcommands.description: Deletes a configuration set.

subcommands.name: delete-configuration-set-event-destination
subcommands.description: Deletes a configuration set event destination.

subcommands.name: delete-configuration-set-tracking-options
subcommands.description: Deletes an association between a configuration set and a custom domain for open and click event tracking.

subcommands.name: delete-custom-verification-email-template
subcommands.description: Deletes an existing custom verification email template.

subcommands.name: delete-identity
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified identity (an email address or a domain) from the list of verified identities.

subcommands.name: delete-identity-policy
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified sending authorization policy for the given identity (an email address or a domain).

subcommands.name: delete-receipt-filter
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified IP address filter.

subcommands.name: delete-receipt-rule
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified receipt rule.

subcommands.name: delete-receipt-rule-set
subcommands.description: Deletes the specified receipt rule set and all of the receipt rules it contains.

subcommands.name: delete-template
subcommands.description: Deletes an email template.

subcommands.name: describe-active-receipt-rule-set
subcommands.description: Returns the metadata and receipt rules for the receipt rule set that is currently active.

subcommands.name: describe-configuration-set
subcommands.description: Returns the details of the specified configuration set.

subcommands.name: describe-receipt-rule
subcommands.description: Returns the details of the specified receipt rule.

subcommands.name: describe-receipt-rule-set
subcommands.description: Returns the details of the specified receipt rule set.

subcommands.name: get-account-sending-enabled
subcommands.description: Returns the email sending status of the Amazon SES account for the current Region.

subcommands.name: get-custom-verification-email-template
subcommands.description: Returns the custom email verification template for the template name you specify.

subcommands.name: get-identity-dkim-attributes
subcommands.description: Returns the current status of Easy DKIM signing for an entity.

subcommands.name: get-identity-mail-from-domain-attributes
subcommands.description: Returns the custom MAIL FROM attributes for a list of identities (email addresses : domains).

subcommands.name: get-identity-notification-attributes
subcommands.description: Given a list of verified identities (email addresses and/or domains), returns a structure describing identity notification attributes.

subcommands.name: get-identity-policies
subcommands.description: Returns the requested sending authorization policies for the given identity (an email address or a domain).

subcommands.name: get-identity-verification-attributes
subcommands.description: Given a list of identities (email addresses and/or domains), returns the verification status and (for domain identities) the verification token for each identity.

subcommands.name: get-send-quota
subcommands.description: Provides the sending limits for the Amazon SES account.

subcommands.name: get-send-statistics
subcommands.description: Provides sending statistics for the current Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: get-template
subcommands.description: Displays the template object (which includes the Subject line, HTML part and text part) for the template you specify.

subcommands.name: list-configuration-sets
subcommands.description: Provides a list of the configuration sets associated with your Amazon SES account in the current Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-custom-verification-email-templates
subcommands.description: Lists the existing custom verification email templates for your account in the current Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-identities
subcommands.description: Returns a list containing all of the identities (email addresses and domains) for your Amazon Web Services account in the current Amazon Web Services Region, regardless of verification status.

subcommands.name: list-identity-policies
subcommands.description: Returns a list of sending authorization policies that are attached to the given identity (an email address or a domain).

subcommands.name: list-receipt-filters
subcommands.description: Lists the IP address filters associated with your Amazon Web Services account in the current Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-receipt-rule-sets
subcommands.description: Lists the receipt rule sets that exist under your Amazon Web Services account in the current Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: list-templates
subcommands.description: Lists the email templates present in your Amazon SES account in the current Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: put-configuration-set-delivery-options
subcommands.description: Adds or updates the delivery options for a configuration set.

subcommands.name: put-identity-policy
subcommands.description: Adds or updates a sending authorization policy for the specified identity (an email address or a domain).

subcommands.name: reorder-receipt-rule-set
subcommands.description: Reorders the receipt rules within a receipt rule set.

subcommands.name: send-bounce
subcommands.description: Generates and sends a bounce message to the sender of an email you received through Amazon SES.

subcommands.name: send-bulk-templated-email
subcommands.description: Composes an email message to multiple destinations.

subcommands.name: send-custom-verification-email
subcommands.description: Adds an email address to the list of identities for your Amazon SES account in the current Amazon Web Services Region and attempts to verify it.

subcommands.name: send-email
subcommands.description: Composes an email message and immediately queues it for sending.

subcommands.name: send-raw-email
subcommands.description: Composes an email message and immediately queues it for sending.

subcommands.name: send-templated-email
subcommands.description: Composes an email message using an email template and immediately queues it for sending.

subcommands.name: set-active-receipt-rule-set
subcommands.description: Sets the specified receipt rule set as the active receipt rule set.

subcommands.name: set-identity-dkim-enabled
subcommands.description: Enables or disables Easy DKIM signing of email sent from an identity.

subcommands.name: set-identity-feedback-forwarding-enabled
subcommands.description: Given an identity (an email address or a domain), enables or disables whether Amazon SES forwards bounce and complaint notifications as email.

subcommands.name: set-identity-headers-in-notifications-enabled
subcommands.description: Given an identity (an email address or a domain), sets whether Amazon SES includes the original email headers in the Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) notifications of a specified type.

subcommands.name: set-identity-mail-from-domain
subcommands.description: Enables or disables the custom MAIL FROM domain setup for a verified identity (an email address or a domain).

subcommands.name: set-identity-notification-topic
subcommands.description: Sets an Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS) topic to use when delivering notifications.

subcommands.name: set-receipt-rule-position
subcommands.description: Sets the position of the specified receipt rule in the receipt rule set.

subcommands.name: test-render-template
subcommands.description: Creates a preview of the MIME content of an email when provided with a template and a set of replacement data.

subcommands.name: update-account-sending-enabled
subcommands.description: Enables or disables email sending across your entire Amazon SES account in the current Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: update-configuration-set-event-destination
subcommands.description: Updates the event destination of a configuration set.

subcommands.name: update-configuration-set-reputation-metrics-enabled
subcommands.description: Enables or disables the publishing of reputation metrics for emails sent using a specific configuration set in a given Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: update-configuration-set-sending-enabled
subcommands.description: Enables or disables email sending for messages sent using a specific configuration set in a given Amazon Web Services Region.

subcommands.name: update-configuration-set-tracking-options
subcommands.description: Modifies an association between a configuration set and a custom domain for open and click event tracking.

subcommands.name: update-custom-verification-email-template
subcommands.description: Updates an existing custom verification email template.

subcommands.name: update-receipt-rule
subcommands.description: Updates a receipt rule.

subcommands.name: update-template
subcommands.description: Updates an email template.

subcommands.name: verify-domain-dkim
subcommands.description: Returns a set of DKIM tokens for a domain identity.

subcommands.name: verify-domain-identity
subcommands.description: Adds a domain to the list of identities for your Amazon SES account in the current Amazon Web Services Region and attempts to verify it.

subcommands.name: verify-email-identity
subcommands.description: Adds an email address to the list of identities for your Amazon SES account in the current Amazon Web Services Region and attempts to verify it.

subcommands.name: wait
subcommands.description: Wait until a particular condition is satisfied.

subcommands.name: identity-exists
subcommands.description: Wait until JMESPath query VerificationAttributes.*.VerificationStatus returns Success for all elements when polling with ``get-identity-verification-attributes``.
